youtube.title: Bread sakht kyun ho jaati hai, jab wo sukhti hi nahi? 🍞 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Bread bahar rakho toh sakht ho jaati hai, par asal mein wo sukhti nahi hai. Baking mein bread ka starch paani soakh leta hai aur naram ho jaata hai.

Jab bread thandi hoti hai, toh wahi starch dheere-dheere paani bahar nikaal deta hai aur wapas akad kar sakht crystals ban jaata hai. Isliye fridge mein bread aur jaldi stale hoti hai. Aur isiliye thoda toast ya garam karne se wo wapas naram ho jaati hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
